algolia.name: CybertronPC - Trooper Desktop - AMD Athlon II X3 - 8GB Memory - 1TB Hard Drive - Black
algolia.description: With a built-in Gigabit Ethernet LAN, this CybertronPC Trooper TGM2211F desktop enables wired connection to the Internet, so you can easily stream a variety of Web-based games and other media. The NVIDIA GeForce GT 620 graphics ensure crisp, realistic visuals.
